scope: Actor main/off/ranged, combat pets and PvE enemy hands use AutoAttackReady in the existing combat heap. Battleground simplified attacks are not migrated.

comparison.result: All remaining state fields, logs, RNG, resources, deaths, assets and existing attack clocks are identical

semantics: At most one queued event per attack timer; a ready timer waits without periodic requeueing
Independent timer identities per hand and replacement incarnation; reset cancels its old queued event
Enemy main-hand lethal damage prevents subsequent offhand/extra damage in the same call, retaining existing clock advancement
Current haste changes affect the next interval; remaining swing progress rescaling is not implemented
limitations: Outer 100ms steps, full unit iteration and ready-timer cleanup remain
No before/after pure CPU measurement; snapshot comparison timing includes copies and assertions
Benchmark runs on local Apple M4 alongside existing local QA services; 3 measured rounds per mode after warmup, no production percentile or capacity claim
Separate simplified battleground pipeline still polls attacks
This runtime hash has not completed the full browser QA matrix; preceding browser evidence retains its older hashes
